messages:
Leah (Finance): FYI AP flagged invoice from NorthernCloud BV - no VAT number on PDF and VAT charged = 0%. Invoice INV-2026-078 for EUR 4,950. Vendor portal shows an OSS reference OSS-NL-4532. Need clear doc or we'll hold payment.
Ben (Payments): placing hold in AP system now. Reason: missing VAT ID / unclear tax treatment. :no_entry_sign:
Priya (Procurement): pinged their account manager (Sofie). She replied they use OSS for EU sales and always bill 0% across the board. Said it's their tax policy.
Leah (Finance): note our buying entity is Redwood Inference EMEA Ltd (Ireland) VAT IE12345678. For cross-border B2B supplies the supplier should either charge VAT and include their VAT ID OR issue without VAT but include reverse-charge note + our VAT ID. OSS is only for B2C seller-side reporting.
Ari (Legal): correct. OSS does not substitute for a VAT registration number for B2B. Ask them to reissue invoice with either (A) supplier VAT ID and VAT charged, or (B) supplier VAT ID omitted but include wording like "Reverse charge - Article 194 TFEU" and our VAT IE12345678 on the invoice.
nc-bot: Payment hold applied by Payments. Ticket #AP-4821 created.
Ben (Payments): if vendor opts to gross-up and add VAT on top, we can accept a reissued invoice with VAT amount and release payment. If they insist on 0% we need supporting legal basis and a searchable registration (VAT ID).
Priya (Procurement): Sofie just emailed: "We don't have a NL VAT number; we operate as an OSS intermediary and cannot provide a VAT ID. We can either keep 0% or gross-up and remit VAT ourselves."
Leah (Finance): OSS intermediary without VAT ID is problematic. Ask for proof of company registration and OSS registration statement. Even then, for our AP policy we need either supplier VAT ID or reissued invoice with reverse-charge + our VAT number.
Ari (Legal): Requested wording we will accept: "Reverse charge - Customer liable for VAT (Art. 194) - VAT number of customer: IE12345678" and supplier signature. Also accept supplier VAT ID if they have one and charge VAT. Otherwise escalation to procurement for alternate supplier selection.
Ben (Payments): updated AP ticket: hold until invoice reissued with required fields or until procurement confirms exception.
Priya (Procurement): told Sofie we need reissue by close of business Friday or we will cancel PO and seek alternate vendor.
Leah (Finance): added requirement to ticket: if vendor provides only OSS reference, we still need a signed attestation from their accounting showing legal basis for 0% + link to national OSS filing. That may be insufficient but we'll review.
Priya (Procurement): Sofie replied: "We can provide a copy of the OSS submission CSV and a signed letter from our accountant. Do you accept that?"
Ari (Legal): OSS filings are system submissions, not a VAT ID. We can accept the signed letter plus reissued invoice with our VAT ID + reverse-charge wording as an alternative. Otherwise they must gross-up.
Leah (Finance): action items: 1) Procurement to collect reissued invoice or attestation by EOD Fri. 2) Payments keeps hold. 3) Legal to sign-off on any attestation if provided. 4) If no acceptable docs, cancel PO and request credit note.
Ben (Payments): noted. Will not release payment until invoice in AP contains either supplier VAT ID OR reverse-charge annotation + our VAT ID, or shows VAT charged.
Priya (Procurement): will follow up and escalate to vendor management if needed. Sofie says she'll try to get reissue today.
Leah (Finance): thanks. marking thread awaiting vendor docs. :spiral_note_pad:
